**The document does not give PPO's or DPO's win rates at temperature 1.0 in the TL;DR plot.** That plot (Figure 2, right) is included only as an image, and the text does not report its values at temperature 1.0.

What the text does say about that plot:

- Completions were sampled at temperatures from 0.0 to 1.0, and win rates were measured against the reference summaries in the test set (p. 9).
- At temperature 0.0, DPO's win rate was about 61% and PPO's was about 57%. Temperature 0.0 was PPO's best temperature (p. 9).
- DPO is "much more robust to the sampling temperature than PPO." PPO's performance "can degrade to that of the base GPT-J model at high temperatures" (p. 9; also the Figure 2 caption, p. 7).

There is one related number, but it measures something different. In the human study (Table 2, p. 10), PPO at temperature 1.0 ("PPO-1") had a GPT-4 (S) win rate of 13%, a GPT-4 (C) win rate of 12% and a human win rate of 17%. Those rates are against PPO at temperature 0, not against the reference summaries, so they are not the values from the Figure 2 plot. The table has no DPO result at temperature 1.0; DPO was evaluated at temperature 0.25 there.
